title: Raisin & Peanut Upma
subtitle: Soft rava upma with golden-fried peanuts, raisins and urad dal, moulded and finished with lemon.
protein: ~9–11g protein per adult serving — from semolina, peanuts and urad dal

method.title: Tempering and roast
items: Heat {@oil} in a heavy pan; add {@raisins}, {@mustard}, {@urad} and {@peanuts}
Fry on low until light golden; add {@hing}
Add {@rava}; stir continuously on low until it gives out a nice aroma — about 7–8 min
Meanwhile keep {@water} at a boil in a separate pot

method.label: Toddler — pull her portion here (before green chili)
items: Scoop {@rava:toddler} of the roasted rava into a small pan — pick out any whole peanuts and crush them back in, and chop the raisins
Pour in {@water:toddler}; stir on low until soft and the water is absorbed, 2–3 min

method.title: Cook the upma
items: Push {@rava:main|the remaining rava} to one side; add {@curry-leaves} and {@green-chili} to the adult pan and stir 30 sec
Carefully pour in {@water:main} and stir well — use a long-handled ladle, it splutters
If it feels too dry, add a splash more water and stir
Keep on low and simmer 2–3 min; add {@lemon} and mix well
Mould into a greased cup and unmould onto the plate; garnish with {@coriander}
Serve hot with coffee or tea, with {@podi}

method.label: Tip
method.text: This is the ¾ batch, sized for two, from the note on the original card (1 cup rava, 3 cups water). The green chilies and curry leaves now go in after the rava is roasted, so her portion comes out first. Hing was added to the tempering.
